analysis.title: "The Make Up Of Momentum Is Changing": AI Stocks Move To The Short Leg As Goldman's 12-Month Momo Has Best Day On Record Vs. Its Shorter Cousins
key_insights: Goldman's 12-month momentum basket (GSPRHIMO) had its best daily outperformance on record (data back to 2016) against its 3-month (GSPRHMO3) and 6-month (GSPRHMO6) baskets on Wednesday, taller than Covid, the 2022 bear market or Liberation Day.
Correlation between 12-month and 3-month momentum has turned negative as the AI trade unwound. Correlation with 6-month momentum is still 0.80.

The number of AI names in the short leg of the 3-month and 6-month momentum baskets has risen sharply while AI names in their long legs have fallen to almost nothing. The 12-month basket still holds about a dozen AI names long.

The November rebalance cut Info Tech by roughly a third of leg notional in both the 3-month and 6-month baskets, with Consumer Discretionary picking up almost all of it. The 12-month basket bought a little tech.
In the 12-month basket Info Tech is 43.4% of the long leg and 16.1% of the short leg (net long 27.3%). Biggest net shorts are Industrials (-18.4%) and Consumer Discretionary (-12.0%).

The 12-month vs 3-month/6-month spread has become a levered bet on whether the AI unwind is over. When AI bounces (semis up more than 8% this week) the 12-month basket rallies and the shorter baskets get squeezed on their AI shorts.
12-month momentum peaked near 400 this summer (indexed to 100 at end-2015) and is at 215, a drawdown of over 40%. The 3-month version is at 99.6.

High Beta TMT Momentum was +125% in the first half and -56% since, about -1% year to date. 3-month momentum went +57% then -40% (about -6% YTD), 6-month +30% then -43% (about -26% YTD). Quality is up about 11% YTD.

Theme returns, first half then second half: Memory +250% then -39% (still +114% YTD), Data Centers +114% then -32%, Inference Chips +127% then -31%. AI Software was +14% then +13%, one of only two AI themes green in both halves (AI Health Care is the other).
AI Semis momentum loading is 0.89, down from a 1.48 peak. Software's loading has crossed to +0.18 from a low of -1.16.

Goldman Prime Brokerage data shows the prime book's net exposure to momentum fell from roughly 60% of fund equity at its 2026 peak to under 10%, the 23rd percentile of its five-year range. Data Center basket crowding is at the 1st percentile over 6 months.

Goldman flagged that a resumption of the rotation could offer tactical shorts in former 12-month momentum short names or broadening beneficiaries where fundamentals do not support the move, naming lower quality software and staples.
Hedge funds shorted staples 5.6 to 1 this week, after staples' best month since October 2000.

Goldman's estimated next momentum rebalance (12-month and 6-month baskets) buys Consumer Discretionary, Communication Services and Health Care and sells Energy and, above all, Info Tech. By industry, Software gains about a quarter of leg notional and Semiconductors & Semi Equipment loses about as much. Oil & gas, construction and engineering and tech hardware are also sold.

60-day realized vol of Goldman's High Beta Momentum basket is 54, down from a mid-80s peak this fall but about 3.5x the S&P 500's 15. Goldman expects rotations and reversals to persist until new long-term leadership emerges.
If the rotation resumes and 3-month and 6-month momentum outperform again, Goldman says 12-month Momentum and Beta could keep lagging and Quality could extend its outperformance.

Peter Oppenheimer sees value in hyperscalers at 19.7x earnings versus Consumer Staples at 21x. This is ZeroHedge's reading of Goldman's strategists, and the article notes Morgan Stanley recommended a similar rotation in July.
Best Goldman baskets over the past five days: Memory +10.1%, Inference Chips +9.7%, IPPs +9.4%, Datacenters +8.8%.

sector_views.rationale: Goldman's estimated November-onward momentum rebalance sells Info Tech above all other sectors, and the 3-month and 6-month baskets cut it by roughly a third of leg notional.
Momentum rebalance flows are estimated to buy Consumer Discretionary, and the shorter-dated baskets added it in November. The article's author is skeptical it can lead.
Estimated rebalance gives Software about a quarter of leg notional in buying, and its momentum loading has turned positive. It still trails semis by 37% YTD on Goldman's pair basket.
Estimated rebalance sells Semiconductors & Semi Equipment by about a quarter of leg notional. SOX is still down roughly a third from its highs.
Goldman's tactical idea includes shorting staples as a rotation beneficiary where fundamentals lag, and the prime book shorted staples 5.6 to 1 this week.
Momentum rebalance estimated to buy Health Care, though hedge funds just sold it at the fastest pace in seven months.
Estimated momentum rebalance sells Energy, including oil & gas.

tension_points.bull_case: 12-month momentum still holds AI winners, semis bounced more than 8% this week, crowding in the Data Center basket is at the 1st percentile, and Oppenheimer sees hyperscalers at 19.7x as cheaper than staples at 21x.
tension_points.bear_case: The 3-month and 6-month baskets are short AI, rebalance flows sell Info Tech and semis and buy software, SOX is still down about a third from its highs, and the author is skeptical the new leaders can carry the market.
tension_points.what_invalidates: If the rotation resumes and 3-month and 6-month momentum go back to outperforming, 12-month Momentum and Beta could keep lagging while Quality extends its outperformance.

theme_stances.key_argument: The 12-month momentum basket is now the last one tied to AI, while shorter baskets have shorted AI names.
theme_stances.evidence: the make up of momentum is changing

theme_stances.key_argument: Quality is the only factor that has made money in both directions this year.
